title: Star Salvage (Template)
description: Starter template — collect orbs, shoot debris, reach 300 points.
detailedDescription: A complete Game Galaxy starter: multi-file architecture (config, engine, renderer, audio, main), sci-fi HUD, touch controls, win/lose flow, and cloud saves via gameBridge. Fork this folder and replace the salvage mini-game with your own.
controls: ← → or A/D move · Space or W fire · Enter start · P pause
